title: Not a genius. I just don't leave things *broken.*
subtitle: I might not be cracked, but I finish what I start.

items.name: Knolt
items.tagline: AI video security for bank branches.
items.text: Knolt's AI watches every camera in a branch and flags a robbery in seconds, with the clip. I fine-tuned an 8B Qwen model into Talos 1.1, our security-camera model, which makes the right incident call 83% of the time on our internal Security-Bench 1.3.

items.name: patch-it
items.tagline: You get the fix, not the alert.
items.text: When a third-party API, package or SDK changes, patch-it finds the code that breaks and drafts the pull request that fixes it, for a person to review. I lead product: the vision, the roadmap and the business model.

details.context: A self-hosted voice-agent platform built on open-source models.
did: Built a self-hosted voice-agent platform with a cascaded speech-to-text → LLM → text-to-speech architecture on open-source models.
Fine-tuned the text-to-speech model with LoRA on the CommissionsQC dataset so it speaks Québec French.

details.context: GameFarm: a distributed mobile-game automation platform running on real Android devices to collect market and monetization data.
did: Built GameFarm's core gameplay loop and GCP infrastructure from scratch.
Replaced screenshot-to-LLM calls with a fast decision model, so each move takes 2 s instead of 10 s.
Demoed it to Xsolla's CTO, then scaled it from 1 to 72 Android devices across 6 countries, coordinating regional operators and writing the deployment docs for a full handoff.
Extended the device grid to support 3 new product initiatives: automated webshop generation, goal-oriented mobile QA and cross-region payment benchmarking, while mentoring intern teams.

details.context: Cloud-native IAM platform serving 130M+ subscribers across 150+ systems at 36K TPS.
did: Automated the reporting for 49-hour stability tests with Claude Skills and MCP integrations across Kubernetes, Jenkins, Grafana and JMeter.
Consolidated redundant schema-drift checks to speed up release validation.
Engineered a Newman/Postman CI pipeline that toggles conflicting Kubernetes pod configs for each test suite.

details.context: Rescuing a company's entire code history from a failing legacy version control system.
did: Deconstructed the legacy system's 32-bit Java SDK.
Built an external-merge-sort pipeline on top of it that stayed under a 1.5 GB JVM limit.
Moved the production code to Git with zero data loss.

influence.label: of production code moved to Git
